repo:objectstack#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbXGvw43spR79ztEvWt

Scope note · 2026-11-18T21:54Z · PR #35244 now ships five rules, not six

`field-boolean-required` was removed from PR #35244 after its premise was disproved (#34776 comment 6989446674). The title's "six" now reads five: four refusals and the `flow-http-timeout-missing` warning. Do not teach a boolean-required trap. If the skills already warn against marking a boolean `required`, correct that text: `required` on a boolean refuses `null`, and an unchecked box counts as present.
